mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(first_use_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dimensionValue, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS value FROM ( SELECT store_id, MIN(create_time) AS first_use_time FROM model_shop_use_record WHERE model_shop_id = #{modelShopId} GROUP BY store_id ) t WHERE first_use_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(first_use_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY dimensionValue ASC
